question: What is the meaning of compatibility in relation to modularity and repairability?
description: Compatibility refers to the ability of different components or systems to work together seamlessly. In relation to modularity, compatibility ensures that parts or modules can be easily assembled or disassembled without issues. For repairability, compatibility means that spare parts or components can be used to repair or upgrade a product, ensuring that the product can be maintained or improved over time.
